import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']
s6_trips = trips[trips['fish_date_season'] == 6].copy()
s6_trips['yt_per_angler'] = s6_trips['yt'] / s6_trips['anglers']

# Analyze by class
class_analysis = s6_trips.groupby('cls').agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum',
    'fish_date_t': 'count'
}).reset_index()
class_analysis.columns = ['cls', 'total_yt', 'total_anglers', 'num_trips']
class_analysis['yt_per_angler'] = class_analysis['total_yt'] / class_analysis['total_anglers']
class_analysis = class_analysis.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)

print("S6 Performance by Class (all agents, DOY 1-121):")
print(class_analysis[['cls', 'yt_per_angler', 'num_trips']].to_string())

# Look at specific DOY ranges for seasonality
print("\n\nS6 Seasonality (yt_per_angler by DOY range, all classes):")
ranges = [
    (1, 50, "DOY 1-50 (Early Spring)"),
    (51, 100, "DOY 51-100 (Mid Spring)"),
    (101, 150, "DOY 101-150 (Late Spring / Summer)"),
    (151, 200, "DOY 151-200 (Summer)"),
    (201, 250, "DOY 201-250 (Late Summer)"),
    (251, 287, "DOY 251-287 (Fall - early Oct)"),
]

for start, end, label in ranges:
    subset = s6_trips[(s6_trips['fish_date_doy'] >= start) & (s6_trips['fish_date_doy'] <= end)]
    if len(subset) > 0:
        total_yt = subset['yt'].sum()
        total_anglers = subset['anglers'].sum()
        avg = total_yt / total_anglers
        print(f"{label}: {avg:.4f} yt/angler ({subset['fish_date_t'].count()} trips)")
    else:
        print(f"{label}: No data")
